arguments.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies user mandate: price $69 (within $100 budget), independent lab certificate CERT-7318 with quality_score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum). Merchant materials confirm independent_outdoor_lab certification with 72-hour wind tunnel, hydrostatic head, pole fatigue and abrasion testing. Syndicated summary from OutdoorGearIndex across 212 verified purchases confirms durability rating 4.8/5 and editor's pick status. TENT-284 rejected: its CERT-4107 is scope-limited to 2P variant only; 4P configuration sold is not certified and carries documented pole-hub and seam-failure complaints with durability rating 3.1/5.
